findings.title: Hold frame time is not cleanly measured (the brief's formal gate passes)
findings.evidence: Run 1 (perf/ab.json): 6 interleaved pairs per mode, SLOT_BG=0, 1-min load 4.7-8.0. Paired medians: move 1.015, rest 1.016, hold 1.007. Hold pairs: 1.007, 0.79, 1.032, 1.487, 1.008, 0.972. Other lanes' Chrome sessions shared the GPU, so frames ran 40-90 ms instead of ~20 ms. Hold ratio of medians was 1.123. Run 2 (perf/ab_hold2.json, hold only, 10 pairs) is invalid: load climbed to 15-57 during it. Its paired median was 1.148 and its ratio of medians 1.133. For comparison, the fixer's contended hold was 0.963 and the builder's valid judge run was 0.986. In the code, the default does 2 noise octaves per chop-zone pixel plus one fwidth in the hold (the builder did 3), and essentially MAIN's rest work.
findings.repro: SLOT_BG=0 node slot.mjs run x -- node judge_p4water/tools/rc2h.mjs --vw 1440 --vh 766 --cycles 0 --restcycles 0 --holdcycles 10 --blockms 2500 --confs "lane=5177|tier=T1&scale=1,main=5199|tier=T1&scale=1" --out FILE, run on a quiet machine
findings.suggested_fix: Re-run the hold A/B before merge, with no other lane's Chrome running and load under 5.

regressions:
No regression against MAIN found. The fix resolved the three regressions from the previous verdict, and I verified each one again myself:
- W1, glint dimming: fixed. Same-clock A/B on the rest frames k0-27 of the deterministic hold path (?p4water=0 vs default): the centre column goes from 180.0 to 184.7, the glint box from 178.7 to 182.1, and the env box p10 from 161.6 to 165.1, all toward F000. shoot_qc q00 / q03 is too noisy at n=2 to settle it either way.
- W2, orbit ghost: fixed, because Q9 is now off by default. On my own default pointer set, the ptr_left box sd4 / lap is 3.32 / 6.93 (MAIN 3.28 / 6.86, builder 2.35 / 4.16) and ptr_right is 3.05 / 7.45 (MAIN 3.08 / 7.65). T1 ident shows the walk / cache / cacheN / mirror targets identical to MAIN's at rest.
- W3, hold flicker: fixed. My new hold capture is bit-identical to the fixer's hold_F2 (480 of 480 frames). Against a new ?p4water=0 capture: press 4.764 -> 4.309 %, sustain 0.688 -> 0.681 %, release 5.113 -> 4.927 %, and the y600-686 band is not worse. The one exception is the local R2 block.
- W5, stepped onset edge: gone.
The switch proof holds. T1 and T2 ?p4water=0 vs :5199 are IDENTICAL (6 targets, 16 programs). The hold pose (expand 2.97, 20 moving frames) with ?p4water=0 is IDENTICAL (18 programs). T0 lane default and envlake=plate&p4water=0 are IDENTICAL. :5199 itself is identical to the 04:37 reference. 0 console lines.
Waterline AA: I ran the diag and leave paths, which the fixer did not re-run. Both show 0 new pop clusters of 6 px or more (diag 2 single px, leave 0), and the AA8 vs lane flagged counts are 1719 / 1716 and 1991 / 1993, so crawl is unchanged. The fixer's medium / fast results are also 0.
Nothing outside the water changed: lane app/ differs from aa8 only in Water.ts, and the patch sha256 902ee34f... reproduces the lane exactly. Same-clock diffs show changes only in y601-765 at rest, y710-765 in the sustain and y580-765 on the way home. The far water (y < 560) is identical.
Perf passes the brief's gate in run 1 (paired move 1.015, rest 1.016, hold 1.007), but on a GPU-contended machine. See R3.
What the fix gave up: the builder's visible hold chop. See R1.
visual_verdict:
The fix round traded G2's still-frame chop for motion that is clean, and it removed the two other regressions:
- At rest the hero frame is MAIN's, plus a slightly brighter and whiter sparkle cluster at the near-water glint, nudged toward F000. F000 still has a much wider, cyan-white, agitated band. The rings are still MAIN's soft bands.
- The far lake and every orbit view look exactly like MAIN again: the corduroy is back and the floe ghost is as faint as MAIN's. The builder's glassier water and its exposed ghost blotches are gone.
- In the hold and pop, the dark navy dashes, the 1-2 px streaks, the stepped chop onset and the extra flicker are gone. Flicker is now at or slightly below MAIN's, except a small patch at the bottom right during the sustained hold.
- But the bottom strip in p05, p06 and every sw_hold frame has mostly gone back to MAIN's smooth pale glass-plate band. The texel stair-steps at the right and a dotted crest line (moved, not removed) remain, so the client's 'weird bottom' is essentially as it is in MAIN. G2 is not delivered.
- Release frames look the same as MAIN's. The thin-tip spot is unchanged.
Net: a small, safe polish over MAIN with no regressions (+0.1 on environment, glitch_hold_sweep and awwwards_jury; cursor orbit and grade equal). It can be merged, but the hold strip still needs a real fix (R1), and the hold frame time needs a quiet-machine re-check (R3).
